# Dale OS — GitHub Copilot entry point

Read `/AGENTS.md` as the repository operating contract.

Use `/machine/failure-classes.json` when the failure mode is already known, then load only the matching canonical `skills/**/SKILL.md` module.

Do not duplicate or reinterpret the skill catalog here. The canonical rules live under `/skills`.

Run deterministic tools for mechanical financial checks. Preserve `UNKNOWN`, `WITHHELD`, `STOP`, and `ESCALATE` when the evidence does not authorize a stronger claim.
